test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 26 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The price of fuel decreases by 30%, 25%, and 45% in three consecutive months, but increases by 45% in the fourth month. By what percent did the price of fuel increase/decrease in the fourth month compared to the original price? (Round the answer to two decimal places.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Successive change formula: Final = Initial × (1 − 30%) × (1 − 25%) × (1 − 45%) × (1 + 45%)

= 100 × 0.70 × 0.75 × 0.55 × 1.45

= 100 × 0.4186875 = 41.86875

Net change = 41.86875 − 100 = −58.13125%

**∴ Answer = 58.13% decrease**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Successive decreases: 30%, 25%, 45%

Then increase: 45%

**Formula used:**

Final value = Initial × (1 ± change%)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Assume initial price = 100

⇒ After 30% decrease ⇒ 100 × 0.70 = 70

⇒ After 25% decrease ⇒ 70 × 0.75 = 52.5

⇒ After 45% decrease ⇒ 52.5 × 0.55 = 28.875

⇒ After 45% increase ⇒ 28.875 × 1.45 = 41.86875

⇒ Net change = 41.86875 − 100 = −58.13125%

⇒ Rounded value = 58.13% decrease

**∴ The correct answer is 58.13% decrease.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

Final value = Initial × (1 + a/100) × (1 + b/100)...

Decrease Formula

After x% decrease ⇒ multiply by (1 − x/100)

Increase Formula

After x% increase ⇒ multiply by (1 + x/100)

Important Note

Successive percentages are multiplicative, not additive
